summary: Prerequisites before coding a new collection: read the module development pages and checklist, aim for PEP 8 and Python 2.6+/3.5+, follow Galaxy naming in your area, commit to maintenance and regular releases, and add unit and integration tests.
questions: What should I do before I start writing modules for a new collection?
What responsibilities come with maintaining a collection?
Are unit tests needed when modules talk to cloud or network devices?

answer_card.title: Before you start coding a collection
answer_card.answer_md:
- Read the module development pages, especially the checklist.
- Aim for PEP 8; support Python 2.6+ and 3.5+.
- Review Galaxy naming conventions in your area (cloud, networking, DB).
- Maintainers must keep content updated, release regularly, and watch issues and contributions.
- Add unit and/or integration tests; unit tests are especially valuable when external resources are needed.
